
.. _aperion.sh:

====================
``utils/aperion.sh``
====================

To simplify the installation and maintenance of an Aperion Search instance you can use the
script :origin:`utils/Aperion-Search.sh`.

.. sidebar:: further reading

   - :ref:`architecture`
   - :ref:`installation`
   - :ref:`installation nginx`
   - :ref:`installation apache`

.. contents::
   :depth: 2
   :local:
   :backlinks: entry


Install
=======

In most cases you will install Aperion Search simply by running the command:

.. code::  bash

   sudo -H ./utils/Aperion-Search.sh install all

The installation is described in chapter :ref:`installation basic`.

.. _aperion.sh overview:

Command Help
============

The ``--help`` output of the script is largely self-explanatory:

.. program-output:: ../utils/Aperion-Search.sh --help
